title: Very basic
text: Very basic. The dehydrator will complete the bottom shelf first so it doesn’t get done at the same time. There is no temperature setting. The auto shutoff is inconvenient if you want to dehydrate something longer than 10 hours. The trays come off very easy so if you have pets try another dehydrator. It sounds like a small fan. I’m unsure of what temperature it dehydrates at because I can’t find that information anywhere.

product_metadata.title: Brentwood Appliances FD1026BK 5-Tray Food Dehydrator with Auto Shutoff, Black
description: Use the Brentwood Appliances 5 Tray Food Dehydrator with Auto Shutoff to make healthy and tasty snacks. The simple 1 touch operation features auto shutoff after 10 hours for added safety. The removable, clear view trays are BPA free and dishwasher safe for easy clean up.
